name: Flaghand
tagline: Agents draft X and LinkedIn posts. Only your passkey approves. Flaghand posts exactly that.
description: Your agent starts at flaghand.com/llms.txt, signs you up, drafts X and LinkedIn posts; you approve. Flaghand is a publishing desk for X and LinkedIn, built for people and their AI agents. Agents draft, upload media, check and request approval over an API, CLI or MCP server; only the account owner approves, with a passkey signed over the exact post, and no agent token can approve or post. X read-back compares normalized text, media count and available alt text, not link targets or media bytes. LinkedIn supports personal profiles, not company pages.

install.notes: Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth; no API key or local server required. Start at https://flaghand.com/llms.txt for agent-led sign-up and the human subscription step. In Cline, authorize Flaghand: the owner signs in with a passkey, chooses a workspace and allows access. Then call getMe to confirm the workspace. Agent access can draft and request approval, but cannot approve, schedule or publish. Manage or revoke access in Flaghand Settings > Agents. Docs: https://app.flaghand.com/docs/agents. Support: support@flaghand.com. Operated by Trellisbyte LLC.
